title: Nioh 3
summary: Cutscene runs with sound, picture black. Same bridge as DYNASTY WARRIORS on a different carrier; its VP9 is decoded by the fix's own reader, since Preview's decoder draws magenta blocks into it.

excerpts.note: The D3D12 renderer opens the handle of a frame decoded on the D3D11 device; the bridge answers with a texture on the game's own device that carries the frame across.
On the D3D11 side IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle returns E_NOTIMPL; the bridge hands out a handle of its own that the D3D12 side recognises.

cause: The game asks for D3D-backed decode on a D3D12 renderer; the frames the D3D11 decoder produces never reach the renderer.
